Parse one JuMP constraint into a multimod equation

Source: R/read_jump.R
parse_jump_equation.Rd

Parse one JuMP constraint into a multimod equation

Usage

parse_jump_equation(text, symbols, model = NULL, desc = "")

Arguments

text

One @constraint(...) statement, as write_jump() emits it or as a modeller writes it. Newlines are allowed.

symbols

Symbol table from build_symbols_list().

model

The model, used to resolve a mapping's declared index names so that JuMP's short aliases come back as the names the model uses.

desc

Description to attach to the equation.

Value

An equation node.

See also

mm_equation() reaches this with lang = "jump".
